statement: IngestionLedger per-call saves make long imports quadratic: mail sync_records measured 8.4 -> 11.2 -> 19.4 ms/message at 500/1,000/2,000 messages. deferred_saves() batches (commit outputs first, then complete + one save) keep it flat at about 1.5 ms/message. Other long importers should batch the same way.
task_summary: Mail bootstrap (EarthLink + iCloud, read-only, multi-account) implemented on branch mail-multi-account (34f72aa5, 1076523a). 53 mail/ingestion tests pass; full suite only fails the 3 known worktree-path tests plus a pre-existing upstream project-count test.
